text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper with an explicit national-scale spatial implementation for China. The primary research focus is on predicting future land system (LULC) changes using the developed GM-FLUS model to simulate China's land system over the next 40 years. It implements four future climate/SSP scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5) with quantitative comparisons of paddy field area changes and potential rice yields. The methodology includes spatial modeling with reported quantitative accuracy metrics (overall accuracy 72.89%, kappa 0.65) and outputs include mapped LULC projections for 2030, 2040, 2050, and 2060.)
